title: He Turned $500,000 Into $1 Billion in 8 Years #shorts
description:
In 2004, Peter Thiel wrote a $500,000 check to a college dropout's website. It became one of the best venture bets in history.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.

lines.text: In two thousand and four, a man wrote a check for five hundred thousand dollars.
Eight years later, it was worth over one billion dollars.
The check went to a website run from a Harvard dorm room.
It had just a few hundred thousand users, and no real profit.
The investor was Peter Thiel, co-founder of PayPal.
He took about ten percent of the company.
Most investors laughed at a site for college kids.
Then it exploded across the planet.
In twenty twelve, it went public at a value of one hundred billion dollars.
Thiel sold most of his shares, and walked away with more than one billion dollars.
One check. One bet nobody believed in.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
